summary: Skip native qdevice teardown when Nex has no service configuration to remove

guide.reason: The absent-witness path had no operator action or configured service; this prevents a stray service-manager call.

api.reason: No Controller/Core or client-facing contract changes; only local qdevice teardown is guarded by Nex's owned drop-in.

roadmap.reason: Witness acceptance remains open and no milestone status changes.

state.reason: The fix adds no durable state; it checks the existing service drop-in before attempting teardown.

verification.method: Run the focused vmhost regression test; inspect the workstation's service state and process list after terminating the stray test process. Broader agent tests remain suspended during incident containment.
